underlines.text: Your coming to Longbourn, to see me and my family

reference.text: Though I know it must be a scandalous falsehood, though I would not injure him so much as to suppose the truth of it possible, I instantly resolved on setting off for this place, that I might make my sentiments known to you.”

underlines.text: I do not pretend to possess equal frankness with your Ladyship.

reference.text: My character has ever been celebrated for its sincerity and frankness; and in a cause of such moment as this, I shall certainly not depart from it.

underlines.text: Your Ladyship has declared it to be impossible.
